synthetic_4task_merge.description: Scaled AdaRank reproduction benchmark, referenced to the paper's ViT-B/32 8-task model-merging results and parameter-cost table.
synthetic_4task_merge.notes: Published avg_accuracy references are the paper's ViT-B/32 8-task values for Individual, Task Arithmetic, and TA+AdaRank. fixed_topk_svd uses the paper's fixed top-16% Task Arithmetic ablation as the compact fixed-rank reference for this scaled gym. The paper does not report balanced_accuracy or worst_task_accuracy aggregates; those are gym-only benefit metrics computed for reproduced artifacts.

avg_accuracy.description: Mean classification accuracy across the synthetic tasks.

balanced_accuracy.description: Mean per-task macro recall, which catches methods that improve the average by neglecting minority classes.

worst_task_accuracy.description: Lowest task accuracy, which catches methods that sacrifice a hard task while preserving the overall mean.

param_multiplier_vs_single.description: Deployment parameter count as a multiple of one merged model; lower values preserve the paper's compactness constraint.

learnable_param_fraction.description: Learnable adaptation parameters as a fraction of all task-specific model parameters; lower values discourage hidden trainable capacity.
